release_notes: V14.44 build 263 is a revision-only OTA validation release based on the corrected build 262. It contains no functional product changes. It preserves the original setup-required and saved-Wi-Fi behaviour while validating the corrected OTA implementation, which performs the GitHub firmware download from the Arduino main loop rather than a separate OTA FreeRTOS task. HTTP/1.1, manual HTTPS redirect handling, extended TLS timeouts, firmware-size validation, SHA-256 verification, native ESP-IDF partition writing and care-alarm OTA protection remain active.
